questions.q: 進行式的時間軸圖，參考的那一刻（現在線或虛線）畫在哪裡？
opts: 落在灰藍長條結束的右邊
落在一排小點的最左邊
跟一個古銅色的點重疊
questions.exp: 進行式表示那一刻動作已經開始、還沒結束，所以參考時刻落在那一段的中間。

questions.q: Please hold. Ms. Huang ______ with another customer at the moment.
questions.exp: at the moment 是此刻正在進行，用現在進行式。

questions.q: The finance team ______ the annual budget when the system crashed.
questions.exp: 系統當機是 when 帶出的短動作（過去簡單式），審預算是被打斷的長動作，用過去進行式；team 當一個單位用 was。

questions.q: ______ the technician was repairing the server, the staff worked on their laptops.
questions.exp: 空格後面是完整子句，而且是一段期間，用連接詞 while；during 後面只能接名詞。

questions.q: This time tomorrow, Mr. Cheng ______ the new staff at the Taichung office.
questions.exp: this time tomorrow 是未來某一刻，那時正在訓練，用 will be＋-ing。

opts: This package contains two power adapters.
This package is containing two power adapters.
This package contain two power adapters.
This package is contain two power adapters.
questions.exp: contain（包含）是描述性質的狀態動詞，用現在簡單式；主詞 this package 單數加 -s。

questions.q: We ______ a farewell party for Ms. Lai on Friday evening; the restaurant is already reserved.
questions.exp: 時間地點已經訂好，是安排好的近未來，用現在進行式；have a party 是動作，可以用進行式。

questions.q: Which sentence uses the verb think correctly?
opts: We are thinking about moving our office to Taichung.
I am thinking that your plan is excellent.
She is think about the offer.
They thinking about a new logo.
questions.exp: think about＝正在考慮，是動作，可以用進行式；think that＝認為，是意見，要用簡單式 I think that。

questions.q: I ______ you three times yesterday, but you didn't pick up.
questions.exp: 打了三次是重複的主要事件，用過去簡單式；過去進行式只用在背景動作。

questions.q: Mr. Lin normally drives to work, but this week he ______ the bus because his car is in the repair shop.
questions.exp: normally 講平常，this week 講暫時的狀況，暫時的用現在進行式。
